entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Norse explorer (c. 970–c. 1020) believed to be the first European to set foot in North America, approximately 500 years before Columbus. Son of Erik the Red, he sailed from Greenland to a land he called Vinland (likely Newfoundland), establishing a brief settlement at L'Anse aux Meadows.
